_about: Characters whose portrait PROMPT changed after their render shipped. The prompt is the character's `look` field — appearance only, kept apart from the desc (Mario, 2026-10-07), so deepening a desc never sends anyone here. gen-portrait-manifest marks them rendered:false / relook:true; the art agent's ship path removes an id once its new render is in web/portraits/thumb/.

peach_lounge_noot.was: Rings on every finger and a voice that cuts the music when she wants it
peach_lounge_noot.why: her look and Min's were dealt swapped; her own hello is the broad, motherly one (dialogue walk 2026-11-02)

hula_hula_min.was: Broad, motherly, and entirely able to have you removed by smiling
hula_hula_min.why: the rings-and-voice look is hers; two of her nodes say rings (dialogue walk 2026-11-02)

hot_pepper_gina.was: A cloud of perfume and authority, hair lacquered against the fans
hot_pepper_gina.why: seven of her eleven nodes put half-moon glasses on her nose (dialogue walk 2026-11-02)

hula_hula_noon.was: Thai woman of thirty-eight, cropped grey-black hair, strong brows, one gold tooth, black singlet, unsmiling.
hula_hula_noon.why: her signature is a neat bun and an engagement ring on a chain, in four nodes (dialogue walk 2026-11-02)

chompoo.was: Thai ladyboy of twenty-five, high cheekbones, dancer's build, cool amused expression, stage bikini.
chompoo.why: a scholarship, five years in Berlin and six on the stage add to about thirty, not twenty-five (dialogue walk 2026-11-02)
